Name: Cable Package
Author: Astraios911
Description:
[center][url=https://postimages.org/][img]https://i.postimg.cc/fTLp6p3J/Features.png[/img][/url][/center]
[url=https://postimages.org/][/url]
Adds 2 new channels to the game (either can be turned off in config):
[list]
[*]The Zuzu Shopping Network: A shopping channel that sells a single random item that changes throughout the day. Compatible with both vanilla and modded items. You need to have 5 hearts with George to get a letter to unlock this channel.[/*]
[*]Miners Beware: a mining channel that tells you which floors of the mines are special type floors, such as slime infestations and dino floors. You need to reach floor 40 to get a letter from Marlon to unlock this channel.[/*]
[/list]
﻿[url=https://postimages.org/][/url]
[center][url=https://postimages.org/][img]https://i.postimg.cc/Yq9ZJZ4v/Compatability.png[/img][/url][/center]
[url=https://postimages.org/][/url]
[list]
[*]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6+.[/*]
[*]Works in multiplayer and split-screen.[/*]
[*]Works on Win/Linux/Mac.[/*]
[*]Works on Mobile.[/*]
[*]Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34820]Watch TV[/url].[/*]
[/list]
